text:
amanda.pm: Sharing a compact rollout / experiment spec for the 'latency-optimized q4 model' — need quick +1s on safety gates and pin rules before I flip this to RFC. TL;DR: staged exposure, opt-in enterprise cohort, automatic rollback heuristics, and observability hooks.

amanda.pm: Proposed rollout schedule (short):
```
Phase 0 (smoke): 0.1% internal traffic, 30m
Phase 1 (pilot): 1% customers opted-in (canary cohort), 2h
Phase 2 (ramp): 10% global traffic, 6h
Phase 3 (full): 100% - gated by success criteria
```

amanda.pm: Acceptance criteria to advance from Phase 2 -> 3:
- P95 latency <= target (550ms)
- Error rate delta vs baseline < 0.5% absolute
- Token cost per request <= 1.05x baseline
- No client-facing regressions in the canary customer set (manual check)

kai.eng: Quick Q: how are we handling version pinning for tenants that opt in? do they get sticky pin for the duration?

samir-prodops: yes — opt-in cohort gets tenant-level pin by default. We propose 24h sticky window, with opt-out allowed via tenant settings. After 24h, we evaluate: if stable, we extend pin; if not, auto-unpin and fallback.

amanda.pm: Exactly. Proposal: pin window = 24h, renew if success criteria met; immediate unpin on rollback trigger.

devon.sre: Rollback triggers from infra perspective:
- sustained 5xx rate > 1% for 5m
- p95 latency increase > 40% over baseline for 5m
- memory or OOM alerts firing on > 2 hosts in same AZ
These should auto-trigger circuit-breaker and traffic shift to previous model variant.

olivia-ml: Add model-quality guard: if semantic eval on our regression set drops by > 2% absolute we should auto-fail and pause ramp. We can run a sampled evaluation job every 15m on production outputs (sample size ~2k tokens) to detect this.

amanda.pm: Good call. I'll add that as a soft-gate for Phase 2 and hard-gate for Phase 3.

samir-prodops: Observability checklist for the run:
- per-tenant latency & error dashboards
- cross-model diff metrics (latency, tokens, cost)
- sample-store of 1% of outputs (redact PII) to enable manual QA
- automatic alerts to #eng-oncall and #product when any gate trips

devon.sre: For automated rollback path we need a safe-landing flow: shift 95% of traffic back in one minute, keep 5% for post-rollback verification, and keep full logs for 24h.

kai.eng: Can we also add a degraded-mode fallback variant that's quantized but cheaper? If the new model fails we can fallback to the quantized variant to avoid total outage.

amanda.pm: Yes — fallback plan: primary -> quantized variant -> previous stable model. Circuit breaker escalation order: fast fallback -> partial rollback -> full rollback.

olivia-ml: For experiment measurement; primary metric is user-perceived latency & completion rate. Secondary: embedding similarity drift (cosine delta) for critical prompts. We'll define an evaluation set of 120 prompt buckets.

samir-prodops: Permissions & customer comms: we need product-approved email template for opt-in invites and an internal flag to block accidental rollout to compliance customers.

amanda.pm: Draft of rollout command for ops (example):
```bash
redwood rollout start --model latency-q4-v2 --cohort pilot --traffic 0.01 --pin-window 24h --watch 15m
```

amanda.pm: Requesting: 
- @kai.eng: confirm infra hooks + config names
- @devon.sre: validate rollback thresholds and pacing controls
- @olivia-ml: sign off on sample eval cadence and metric set
- @samir-prodops: comms + tenant pin UX constraints
Reply here with :thumbsup: or small edits, otherwise I'll convert to RFC by EOD.

kai.eng: Confirmed. I can add the config keys: rollout.coordinator.pin_window, rollout.coordinator.fallback_order, rollout.watch_interval. I'll push a small PR to the infra repo after this thread. :+1:

devon.sre: Rollback thresholds look good. Suggest one tweak: add a staged rollback pace param (default 95% revert/min) and keep a manual override flag.

olivia-ml: Sign-off on eval cadence. Suggest increasing sample size to 3k tokens if Phase 2 crosses >5% traffic.

samir-prodops: I'll draft the opt-in email and add a tenant blocklist for regulated accounts. Also agree on 24h pin window. :thumbsup:

amanda.pm: Awesome — I'll update the doc with these edits and open RFC. Leaving the thread open for any late objections.

redwood-bot: Reminder: RFC template checklist updated — include rollout safety section and experiment metrics. See /rfc-template.

kai.eng: tiny nit: change "pilot" -> "pilot-optin" in CLI example to avoid confusion with internal pilot.

amanda.pm: Done. Thanks everyone. Planning to move to RFC by 18:00 UTC.
